pages.title: Soup’s On!
pages.text: Collect completed Potato Soup from a Cooking Pot.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Heat the pot, add the Potato Soup ingredients and prepare its serving container. JEI shows the pot-cooking recipe.

pages.title: Cook over heat
pages.text: The Cooking Pot and Roaster need heat below, ingredients and serving containers in separate slots. Flame, particles and sound indicate processing; ingredient properties depend on the recipe.
